tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Compare Scan Series
tool.description: compare normalized results from a mapped scan series
tool.command: touch '$comparison_table' '$comparison_report' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$comparison_table' '$comparison_report' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p summaries && #for $index, $summary in enumerate($summaries) ln -s '$summary' 'summaries/summary_${index}.json' && #end for python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py compare-series --summary-dir summaries --csv-output '$comparison_table' --html-output '$comparison_report' > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)

param.name: summaries
param.label: RADAR-PD normalized summaries
param.help: Connect the mapped summary output from RADAR-PD Analyze.

tool.help: Combines normalized RADAR-PD summaries from a Galaxy mapped collection into a compact comparison table and HTML report. It is intended for sequential scans, temperature or field series, and repeated live-acquisition reductions. Each upstream analysis remains independently reproducible in Galaxy history.
